specs.title: Booking lifecycle notifications
specs.why: Automatic confirmations and reminders are the feature merchants ask for first.
specs.scope: Send WhatsApp with SMS fallback on create, confirm, cancel and reschedule, with retries and a dead-letter queue.
tasks: Add `prisma/schema.prisma`: add the `DeadLetter` model and a view in `app/(app)/admin/dlq/page.tsx`
acceptance: All four lifecycle events dispatch a message, verified by `pnpm test`
A WhatsApp failure falls back to SMS
A permanently failed message appears in `DeadLetter`

specs.title: Reminder scheduler
specs.why: Reminders are the single highest-leverage lever on no-show rate.
specs.scope: T-24h and T-2h reminders per booking with a per-tenant toggle and duplicate-safe scheduling.
tasks: Add `scripts/reminder-cron.ts`: add the job running every 5 minutes
acceptance: Two parallel workers send exactly one reminder, verified by `pnpm test`
Reminder dispatch falls within 5 minutes of the target time
Disabling the toggle stops subsequent reminders
